This repository is HagopJay's working fork of the Blender extension Web3D X3D/VRML2 format
Its purpose is to bring the exporter and importer up to X3D 4.0 (ISO/IEC 19775-1:2023)
Principled BSDF → PhysicalMaterial (baseColor, metallic, roughness, emissiveColor, transparency, normalScale, occlusionStrength)
Emission-only trees → UnlitMaterial
Everything the 4.0 option writes, plus Gaussian-splat objects as the draft GaussianSplats node (component GaussianSplats level 1)
Gaussian-splat objects as the draft GaussianSplats node (component GaussianSplats level 1)
The header declares <component name="Shape" level="2" /> whenever it writes PhysicalMaterial or UnlitMaterial
X_ITE 16.4.3 renders the node, including a 500,000-splat scene written by this exporter.
draft GaussianSplats node (component GaussianSplats level 1)
The X3D 4.0 writer validates its own output: XML well-formedness always, and field types and ranges through the Web3D x3d Python package when it is installed
field types and ranges through the Web3D x3d Python package when it is installed (pip install x3d)
The X3D 4.0 writer validates its own output: XML well-formedness always, and field types and ranges through the Web3D x3d Python package when it is installed (pip install x3d).
Quaternions are written as x y z w, the glTF KHR_gaussian_splatting order the draft node mirrors.
An Empty with a custom property x3d_inline_url (for example parts/wheel.glb, cloud.ply, room.x3d) exports as an <Inline url=…> inside its Transform
On import an Inline becomes such an Empty with the referenced asset loaded underneath it
.gltf / .glb through Blender's glTF importer
Blender 5.3's native splat PointClouds (what its PLY, SPZ, glTF and USD importers create)
With the 4.0 option the same objects degrade to a coloured PointSet and a <meta name="info"> says so.
